questions.question: How many Medicare-certified hospice facilities were operating nationwide in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 1_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Type of Facility', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
col_2023 = years.index('2023')

hospice_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Hospices'].index[0]
result = int(df.iloc[hospice_row, col_2023])

questions.question: In calendar year 2023, did Florida have more Medicare-certified short stay hospital beds than California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 4_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Provider State', na=False)].index[0]
cols = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
short_stay_bed_col = [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if 'Short Stay Hospital Beds' in c and 'Per 1,000' not in c][0]

fl_beds = float(df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'].iloc[0, short_stay_bed_col])
ca_beds = float(df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].iloc[0, short_stay_bed_col])

result = 'yes' if fl_beds > ca_beds else 'no'

questions.question: Which three states had the highest number of Medicare-certified ambulatory surgical centers in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 5_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Provider State', na=False)].index[0]
cols = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
asc_col = cols.index('Ambulatory Surgical Centers')

start_idx = header_row + 1
end_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Territories', na=False)].index[0]
state_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
state_df = state_df[~state_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(['All Areas', 'United States', 'BLANK', ''])]
state_df['asc'] = pd.to_numeric(state_df.iloc[:, asc_col], errors='coerce')
top3 = state_df.sort_values(by='asc', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3.iloc[:, 0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: How many states had zero Critical Access Hospitals in 2023 according to the state-level provider tables?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 4_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Provider State', na=False)].index[0]
cols = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
cah_col = cols.index('Critical Access Hospitals')

start_idx = header_row + 1
end_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Territories', na=False)].index[0]
state_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
state_df = state_df[~state_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(['All Areas', 'United States', 'BLANK', ''])]
state_df['cah'] = pd.to_numeric(state_df.iloc[:, cah_col], errors='coerce')
# Exclude District of Columbia if focusing strictly on 50 states, or check if DC is included in rows
# The table lists 50 states + District of Columbia (51 rows). DC has 0, CT has 0, DE has 0, MD has 0, NJ has 0, RI has 0 (total 6 in that section)
result = int((state_df['cah'] == 0).sum())

questions.question: What was the net change in the number of Medicare nurse practitioners between 2019 and 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 6_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Specialty', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
col_2019 = years.index('2019')
col_2023 = years.index('2023')

np_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Nurse Practitioner'].index[0]
np_2019 = float(df.iloc[np_row, col_2019])
np_2023 = float(df.iloc[np_row, col_2023])

result = int(np_2023 - np_2019)

questions.question: Between 2018 and 2023, in which calendar year did the total count of Medicare-certified hospitals peak?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 1_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Type of Facility', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row][1:]]

total_hosp_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Total Hospitals'].index[0]
counts = [float(df.iloc[total_hosp_row, i]) for i in range(1, 1 + len(years))]
max_year = years[counts.index(max(counts))]
result = str(max_year)

questions.question: What was the total number of Medicare-certified skilled nursing facility beds across all areas in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 2_CPS_19PRV', header=None)

# Find row for Skilled Nursing Facilities then the 'Number of beds' row under it
snf_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Skilled Nursing Facilities')].index[0]
beds_idx = snf_idx + 1

questions.question: Across all 50 states and D.C., how many states had at least 1,000 Medicare-certified rural health clinics in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 5_CPS_19PRV', header=None)

# State rows run from Alabama (index 7, row 8) to Wyoming (index 57, row 58)
states_df = df.iloc[7:58]
# Column H is index 7, which corresponds to Rural Health Clinics
rhc_counts = pd.to_numeric(states_df[7], errors='coerce')
result = int((rhc_counts >= 1000).sum())

questions.question: Which type of non-profit skilled nursing facility control category had the largest number of certified facilities in 2023: church-related, corporation, or other?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 3_CPS_19PRV', header=None)

categories = ['Non Profit - Church Related', 'Non Profit - Corporation', 'Non Profit - Other']
subset = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(categories)]
# 2023 is column 6
best_row = subset.loc[pd.to_numeric(subset[6]).idxmax()]

questions.question: Which five physician specialties had the highest number of Medicare non-institutional practitioners in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 6_CPS_19PRV', header=None)

# All Physician Specialties starts around row 8 and goes until Non-Physician Practitioners at row 80
# Rows 9 to 78 contain physician specialties and section subheaders
phys_df = df.iloc[8:78].copy()
# Drop section headers (which have NaN in column 5 / 2023 count)
phys_df[5] = pd.to_numeric(phys_df[5], errors='coerce')
phys_df = phys_df.dropna(subset=[5])

top5 = phys_df.sort_values(by=5, ascending=False).head(5)
result = [str(x).strip() for x in top5[0].tolist()]
